notes: The entire fixed supply is minted once to the deployer. The launch factory distributes 10% through its Merkle distributor and seeds 90% into the pool. Every transfer from the specified PoolManager to another address sends floor(amount / 50) to the fixed treasury; incoming PoolManager and wallet transfers are untaxed. No owner, admin, mint, burn or upgrade entry points. The pool initialPrice is provenance only; the factory derives the opening price from economics and deployed currency order.
